MaxEffects.Name: Maximum simultaneous animations
MaxEffects.Hint: When this many animations are playing, the oldest short animation is removed to make room. Persistent animations (auras) are never removed.

CacheSize.Name: Animation cache size
CacheSize.Hint: How many animation files are kept loaded in memory. Higher values avoid reloading, lower values save memory.

DebugOverlay.Name: Show animation debug overlay
DebugOverlay.Hint: Display counters (active animations, cached files, video elements, FPS) in the corner of the canvas.
